text:
Sam W: Heads up — after the BMC microcode push last night we’re seeing OOB serial disconnects in eu-west-1. provisioning jobs ~10% fail, several GPUs left in 'reserved' state. any quick wins?
Maria L: saw the spike too. jump-host proxies show repeated keystore handshake timeouts. looks correlated to HSM rotation window at 02:15 UTC.
Alex P: can we pause the rollout for the remaining racks? rolling back microcode per rack might be safer than mass rollback.
Sam W: pausing now — stopped staging push at 02:42. can we repro on a single rack and verify secure-boot flags aren’t toggling?
Maria L: repro steps I used: repro boot -> server hits OOB proxy -> proxy auth stalls -> bmc drops session. logs: \n```
Jun 07 02:17:03 proxy[1867]: keystore: timeout waiting for HSM response
Jun 07 02:17:03 bmc[ttyS0]: session closed, reason=auth-failure
```
Alex P: thanks. Jin, can you run a targeted repro on rack eu-west-1a-07? if the keystore answer is slow we may trigger secure-boot fallback on some boards.
Jin C: on it. running repro now, will narrow to nodes with old TPM firmware. quick query I ran: `rg "keystore: timeout" /var/log/oob/*.log | cut -d' ' -f1 | sort | uniq -c` — hit 8 nodes so far.
ops-bot: rollback job scheduled: rollback/bmc-mc-2026-06-07 -> queued on eu-west-1 staging racks (owners: @Sam W).
Maria L: plan: 1) hold rollout, 2) run targeted revert on flagged racks, 3) repro with HSM stub to ensure keystore latency handled, 4) add short-circuit to jumphost to avoid session thrash.
Alex P: also add capacity plan — divert new provisioning to us-west-2 for 12h to avoid customer impact. estimate extra GPU cost ~+$1.2k for 12h.
Sam W: agreed. Jin please post results and node list. if secure-boot flags flipped we’ll need manual attestation rollback.
Jin C: done — posted node list in thread, repro shows 6/8 nodes hit the BMC session drop, secure-boot remained set but KV cache got stale causing provisioning state stuck.
Maria L: mitigation executed: cleared BMC KV cache on affected nodes, forced reprovision, jobs resumed. keeping rollout paused until we validate HSM rotation scheduling and add retry/backoff in proxy.
Sam W: marking incident as P2. will open follow-up to revisit HSM rotation windows and add a canary that exercises keystore path at rotation time. :thumbsup:
